subject.title: feat: sidebar update card (web + macOS) with app-first mac update flow and Sparkle beta track

question: Should this PR land the automatic managed-Gateway repair and beta-channel UI before the beta appcast publisher is operational, or should delivery and real upgrade proof be completed first?
rationale: The code makes an intentional upgrade-policy change and exposes a beta track whose public delivery depends on a separate private release workflow, so repository evidence cannot determine the acceptable rollout boundary.

options.title: Complete delivery first
options.body: Hold the PR until beta appcast publishing is operational and signed-app fresh/upgrade proof demonstrates the automatic repair and restart path.

options.title: Land stable flow only
options.body: Narrow the PR to the sidebar and app-first stable update path, deferring beta-channel claims and documentation until publication exists.

options.title: Accept staged rollout
options.body: Merge the current implementation while explicitly documenting that beta app discovery remains inactive until the private publisher changes.

recommendation.title: Complete delivery first
recommendation.body: Hold the PR until beta appcast publishing is operational and signed-app fresh/upgrade proof demonstrates the automatic repair and restart path.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and prior merged history show ownership of the macOS managed-Gateway and Control UI product direction involved in this choice.
